description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of normalized scores across several Korean benchmark datasets for three language models. The horizontal axis contains the category labels PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, arranged left to right in that order, while the vertical axis represents score values on a linear scale from 0 to 1.00 (with values shown as numeric annotations above bars rather than explicit tick marks). Each category shows a grouped set of three vertical bars: a dark navy bar for “RedWhale (our),” a light blue bar for “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and a light gray bar for “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base),” with the gray bar annotated as 1.00 in every group. The annotated values for RedWhale are approximately 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.70 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.59 (AVG), and for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 are approximately 0.46, 0.56, 0.74, 0.54, 0.73, and 0.61 for the same categories, respectively. The bars are not shown as sorted by magnitude; they follow the benchmark order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the value labels above each bar.
